facts.claim_en: Under federal IDEA rules, the state education agency has a 60-day time limit after a written state complaint is filed to investigate and issue a decision.
facts.claim_es: Según las reglas federales de IDEA, la agencia estatal de educación tiene un límite de 60 días después de presentada una queja estatal por escrito para investigar y emitir una decisión.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Education, IDEA regulations, 34 CFR 300.152
facts.quote: Each SEA must include in its complaint procedures a time limit of 60 days after a complaint is filed

facts.claim_en: Under federal IDEA rules, the school district must hold a resolution meeting within 15 days of receiving a parent's due process complaint, before a hearing begins.
facts.claim_es: Según las reglas federales de IDEA, el distrito escolar debe hacer una reunión de resolución dentro de los 15 días después de recibir la queja de debido proceso de los padres, antes de la audiencia.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Education, IDEA regulations, 34 CFR 300.510
facts.quote: Within 15 days of receiving notice of the parent’s due process complaint, and prior to the initiation of a due process hearing
